content.text: *Homans’ sign (calf pain on passive foot dorsiflexion) is UNRELIABLE for presence of DVT
massive iliofemoral VTE occludes deep + superficial veins
full compressibility of all imaged veins
non-compressibility of imaged vein w/ pressure
*CT/MR venography previously gold standard, now rarely used
IVC filter only recommended if CI to AC
Choice of agent for secondary tx
AC w/ DOAC recommended over ASA
➀ DC AC following primary tx
